name: Weckenmann shuttering robot (3rd generation)
summary: Multifunctional gantry robot for precast pallet circulation plants that sets formwork profiles and magnets on the pallet, demoulds them after curing and handles their storage, optionally with an integrated plotter. Weckenmann in Dormettingen, Germany, says it built the world's first shuttering robot in 1992.

germany.statusNote: German maker (now part of the Belgian Construx Group); sold on request through Weckenmann sales in Dormettingen. No price published.

notes: Gantry (portal) robot over the pallet line with a gripper head for shutter profiles.
An older Weckenmann design, the Twin-Z, adds a second vertical axis (BFT International).
Speed, accuracy and payload are not given on the pages read.
